protocol.order: complete baseline cohort, then complete candidate cohort; no overlapping GPU benchmarks
protocol.keep_rule: all 40 runs per cohort; no per-fixture expected-outcome reduction; lower overall median turns or seconds
limitations: One sequential cohort per version; stochastic model responses and thermal/order effects are uncontrolled.
Offline fake-model tests briefly overlapped the baseline; no extra GPU model workload was started.
Fixtures are small synthetic checkouts; results do not establish gains on large repositories.
